rationale: The analysis accurately identifies the positional mapper as the defect, distinguishes validator symptom-surfacing from causation, explains deterministic retry failure, and prioritizes named-field mapping plus stronger contract tests. It is highly evidence-grounded and appropriately preserves residual uncertainties. A few assertions slightly overreach the supplied evidence, such as treating retries as ruling out all transient causes and some claims about diagnostic misdirection or full resolution beyond the corrected sample, but these do not materially alter the core diagnosis or actions.
